clock.note: ASSUMED: the CONUSS calculation has t = 0 at excitation and no fitted time offset

release.logic: a release gate t_g removes all nuclear counts before t_g; the data exceed the prompt-tail/background ceiling by >5 sigma in every column from t = 1.92 ns to 3 ns, so t_g < that time

marxglowna21.ref: Marx-Glowna, Uschmann, Schulze, Marschner, Wille, Schlage, Stoehlker, Roehlsberger, Paulus, "Advanced X-ray polarimeter design for nuclear resonant scattering", J. Synchrotron Rad. 28, 120 (2021), PMC7842219
